channel.title: Holistic Life: Gifts for Nurses and Healthcare Workers
channel.description: Gifts for Nurses and Healthcare Workers guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Nurse Gifts for a New Grad: What a First-Year Nurse Will Use
item.description: Nurse gifts for a new grad's first year on the floor. A short checklist of gear that gets used every shift, plus what to ask first before buying a stethoscope. See what to look for in each. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Nurses That Actually Get Used: 12 Practical Ideas
item.description: Gifts for nurses that get used every shift: compression socks, a leakproof bottle, a fob watch, sleep helpers for night shift and more. Twelve practical ideas from a nurse-run site, with what to look for in each one. Guide contains affiliate links.
